soa_notes.text: Refer to the laboratory manual for sample collection, processing and shipping.
Isatuximab PK or ADA predose samples should be collected before isatuximab administration and at the same time as atezolizumab predose samples when applicable.
Atezolizumab sample collected strictly before the start of atezolizumab infusion (during treatment phase).
P04 sample must be collected even if the participant withdraws the study without receiving the second administration of isatuximab.

After start of study treatment, if 1 drug is prematurely discontinued, ADA samples for this drug will be collected and tested on Day 1 of the 2 next cycles. The ADA sample collection for other drug should be done as planned.
Sample collected just before actual end of infusion of isatuximab.
Isatuximab sample collected strictly before the start of isatuximab infusion (during treatment phase).
After FUP 90(±7) days after last isatuximab administration no further ADA will be sampled even if the status is positive or inconclusive.

Isatuximab PK and ADA samples to be collected each cycle until the last study treatment for PK and until FUP 90(±7) days after last IMP administration for ADA or at the cut-off date, whichever comes first. However, collection can be reduced or stopped earlier upon notification from the Sponsor based on the updated knowledge of isatuximab on PK/ADA.
For subsequent cycles, atezolizumab PK and ADA samples (pre-dose) are to be collected at Cycle 8 Day 1 and Cycle 16 Day 1 only.
Biomarker blood draw may be performed within 1 working day prior to IMP administration.
